sentences.text: Marin Consulting Oy is a newly registered company, entered in the register on 2026-08-31 under the industry code 73112, other activities of advertising agencies.
First sales are recorded on 2026-08-31, and a start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-09-04.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the name has a marine word, but the registered industry is advertising and the record shows no ocean use.
